text:
release-coordinator: Quick heads-up — release train 12.4 is entering code freeze at 18:00 PST today. This is a hard freeze for feature merges to master and release/12.4. Only bugfixes, security patches, and documented freeze-exceptions allowed. Please follow the exception flow below.

release-coordinator: Pre-freeze actions (please ack):
• run local test matrix
• verify canary pass results
• confirm migrations scheduled (if any)

maya: acked. tagging services that touch embeddings and routing. :eyes:

samir: FYI — DB migration for feature flags scheduled at 16:30 PT, it's a backwards-compatible add-column. olivia to run.

olivia: I'll run the migration and watch for lock timeouts. ETA ~30m. I have rollback SQL ready.

release-bot: preflight-checks: 14/15 checks passed. Warning: schema-staleness detected for service-catalog. See https://ci.internal/runs/9876 :warning:

maya: taking the schema warning, will submit a small patch.

tj: Canary summary for model-route text-gen: 2% traffic, p50 48ms, p95 180ms, error-rate 0.12% (baseline 0.1%). Small uptick at p95 but tolerable. Logs show occasional GC spikes from older workers.

release-coordinator: Thanks tj. If p95 trends upward after migration, we'll throttle canary to 0% and roll back.

samir: Requesting freeze-exception: PR#842 — bump OpenSSL to 3.1 to address CVE-2026-xxxx. Tests: unit+integration green, canary staging green. Link: https://git.internal/r/842

sec-team: Reviewed PR#842. Security approves the OpenSSL bump, but requires runtime validation post-deploy. :heavy_check_mark:

release-coordinator: Exception approved (sec + eng-leads). samir, please add /freeze-except command with PR link and add owner label.

samir: done. /freeze-except https://git.internal/r/842 owner:@samir notes:"OpenSSL bump — security-approved"

release-bot: freeze-exception logged: id FE-221, requested_by samir, status: pending-deploy.

olivia: Migration started (16:29 PT). No locks observed so far. tail -n 50 /var/log/migrations.log shows progress: \n```
2026-03-23T16:29:02Z start migration feature_flags_v2
2026-03-23T16:29:30Z apply alter table add column
2026-03-23T16:30:10Z commit
```

olivia: Migration complete at 16:31 PT, no rollbacks needed.

tj: Canary rollback trigger test executed locally (sim), confirmed rollback path works.

maya: patch for schema staleness submitted as PR#853. Runs on CI now.

release-bot: CI status summary — PR#842: green, PR#853: running (2/6 jobs done).

release-coordinator: Final reminders:
• No feature merges after 18:00 PST without exception.
• If you need an emergency change after freeze, open /freeze-except with justification + tests + owner.
• Shift leads: monitor canaries for next 4 hours.

maya: will monitor routing and embeddings latency. ping if anything spikes.

tj: will keep an eye on canary dashboards, will call rollback if p95 > 250ms for 5min.

samir: thanks everyone — prepping the deploy window notes.

release-coordinator: Appreciate the quick turn. I'll post a short freeze announcement to #general at 18:05 PST. :bell:

olivia: good luck, pushing the runbook to the ops channel now.

release-bot: deploy window opens 18:15 PST. Preflight: all critical checks green.

maya: :thumbsup:
